units.source_text: 下午，千重子上后面楼上化妆，虽不是浓妆艳抹，但也费了一番功夫。

en.t: That afternoon, Chieko went upstairs at the back of the house to put on her makeup. It was not heavy makeup, but it still took her quite some effort.

units.source_text: 她细心地梳理着长发，但总也梳不成称心的发型。

en.t: She carefully combed her long hair, but no matter what she did, she could not arrange it into a style she liked.

units.source_text: 要穿的衣裳也不知挑哪件好，挑来挑去，反倒决定不下来。

en.t: As for what to wear, she could not decide which outfit to choose; after going through them again and again, she only became less able to make up her mind.
